summary: Manager, Finance Data Analytics & Insights candidate with ~7 years across pension and institutional investment analysis, valuation, risk, and reporting-transformation work. CFA charterholder holding delegated sign-off on valuation and sensitivity outputs for institutional portfolios of $5-25bn per engagement, who re-engineered manual spreadsheet workflows into auditable Python analytics pipelines and translated institutional clients' investment requirements (including pension funds) into scoped platform solutions. Earlier delivered IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 reporting-transformation work at EY and pension ALM and LDI studies at Ortec Finance.
core_skills: Pension ALM, Funding Ratio & LDI Analytics

sections.heading: Valuation, Risk & Portfolio Analytics for Institutional Clients
bullets: Hold delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and ALM outputs delivered to institutional client portfolios of $5-25bn per engagement (~$50bn+ cumulative), independently reviewing curve construction, spread calibration, and cross-asset interactions before release.
Review aggregation logic converting security-level exposures into portfolio-level risk metrics that feed downstream ALM, capital, and reporting processes for institutional and pension clients.

Prepare analytical summaries and management reporting for senior stakeholders on interest-rate exposure, scenario impacts, and portfolio sensitivities, translating quantitative output into investment-committee-ready narratives.

sections.heading: Analytical Tool Development & Process Automation
bullets: Re-engineered manual spreadsheet workflows into scalable Python analytics pipelines with embedded logging, validation, and auditability controls.
Led design and implementation of an enterprise multi-asset cash flow projection engine supporting base, stress, and reverse-stress scenarios across multi-year horizons.

Built agentic AI development workflows (Claude Code, Cursor IDE) automating code generation, validation scaffolding, anomaly detection, and documentation, reducing development cycle time an estimated 30-40% on comparable modules.

sections.heading: Governance, Documentation & Stakeholder Partnership
bullets: Serve on the model governance committee, participating in methodology review, documentation and benchmarking standards, and model-performance assessment for client-delivered analytics.
Act as escalation point for client-critical analytical issues, interfacing directly with clients' Heads of Risk and investment stakeholders, and escalating outputs lacking economic defensibility.
Led onboarding and implementation for U.S. and Canadian pension funds, asset managers, and consulting firms adopting PFaroe DB (risk & ALM analytics) and PFaroe PM (portfolio management).
Translated investment-team requirements into scoped Product Owner requests for development, advised on asset, liability, and ALM configuration, and validated model outputs post-deployment.
Contributed to the migration of all assigned client accounts from the legacy Calypso platform to PFaroe PM without loss of reporting continuity.
Delivered IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 transformation projects for Canadian and international insurance clients, aligning regulatory requirements with system implementation and financial reporting frameworks.
Coordinated cross-functional actuarial, finance, IT, risk, and program-management teams on milestone delivery, governance documentation, and regulatory-readiness materials.
Delivered ALM studies for Canadian and international pension funds and institutional investors, analyzing funding ratios, duration mismatch, and long-term balance-sheet risk exposures.

Performed asset-only and asset-liability (surplus) portfolio optimization on VaR and CVaR using Ortec's GLASS platform, with risk decomposition and attribution (contribution-to-risk, risk budgeting) and near-optimal frontier analysis to test allocation robustness.
Built and interpreted stochastic economic scenario generators assessing interest-rate risk and funding volatility under base-case and stressed environments.
Modelled pension-fund actuarial liabilities alongside all major investment-product types and economic variables, and conducted LDI analysis on duration alignment, return objectives, and liquidity.

Led onboarding and the ALM study for a three-plan university pension merger, on a team of three developing and validating the model capturing all Funding Policy dynamics, duration, currency, inflation, and leverage overlays.
Presented study findings and allocation recommendations to investment committees at Canadian pension-fund clients on-site.

education: MSc, Chemical Engineering (Full Scholarship) - Western University, 2016
